I told Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team that the settled figure for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is **261 seats**.

- **Source:** Ilse posted that number in #north-team on Oct 14. Dana is a member of that channel, so she can see it herself.
- **Older figure:** I warned her not to confuse it with 185 seats. That number is from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025, which she had corrected from 180 at the time.
- **Not confirmed against the contract:** Moss's March digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, but the signed copy isn't in any file Dana can see. Ilse's post is the only source, so I suggested she check with Ilse or June if she needs it verified.

Seat counts are operational facts rather than finance figures, so no approval was needed.

One thing you should know: the channel history shows my wrap-up from Ilse's request (ts 1791986400.000125) was posted into #north-team as a channel message. It doesn't contain anything sensitive, but it's leftover bot chatter you may want removed.
